reason: A local Electron desktop workspace for managing AI sessions, agents, tools, projects, files, browser research, Git worktrees, and document artifacts through DeepSeek Harness.

summaries.zh: 一个基于 Electron 的本地 AI 工作桌面，用于管理 DeepSeek Harness 会话、智能体、项目、文件、网页研究、Git Worktree 和 Office 产物。
summaries.en: A local Electron AI workspace for managing DeepSeek Harness sessions, agents, projects, files, web research, Git worktrees, and Office artifacts.

capabilities: Runs local AI sessions with agents, tools, skills, MCP integrations, hooks, sub-agents, and workflows
Reads and searches project files and can write files or apply model-generated changes with user authorization
Provides browser workspace features including web access, downloads, printing, snapshots, and site permissions
Creates and edits Canvas, Site, Markdown, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, and PDF artifacts
Installs DSH Profile Bundles from versioned npm packages or external repositories after compatibility checks
Manages Git worktrees and project-scoped working directories
